run_zerodepth_on_spot: run the try_zerodepth script to predict depth from a Spot robot camera image using ZeroDepth
load_zerodepth_model: load the pretrained ZeroDepth model from TRI-ML/vidar via torch.hub and move it to GPU
connect_spot_client: instantiate a SpotClient with a config and start it to connect to a Spot robot
get_rgbd_observation: call get_rgbd_obs on the SpotClient to retrieve RGB, depth, camera intrinsics, and pose
predict_depth_from_rgb: pass an RGB tensor and camera intrinsics to the ZeroDepth model to predict a depth map
unproject_depth_to_xyz: use unproject_masked_depth_to_xyz_coordinates to convert a depth map and camera pose into 3D point cloud coordinates
visualize_point_cloud: use show_point_cloud to render and display a 3D point cloud with RGB color mapping
